title: Microsoft AI-103 Blueprint Major Refresh (v2.0-2025)
summary: Mandatory migration to Conversational Language Understanding (CLU), Azure AI Search Vector/Hybrid retrieval, and Document Intelligence v3.1 API. Form Recognizer and LUIS content marked as deprecated.

title: Cognitive Search Renamed to Azure AI Search with Semantic Ranker GA
summary: Azure Cognitive Search officially rebranded to Azure AI Search. General availability of vector search, exhaustive KNN, and Semantic Ranker integration.

title: LUIS (Language Understanding) Full Sunset Announcement
summary: LUIS runtime will be fully retired. All new conversational applications must target Azure AI Language Conversational Language Understanding (CLU).
